fieldData.awb---how-to-step-2-des: A visitor who never presses play still needs the offer. Put the headline and the main call to action beside or under the video, and write the headline so it makes sense on its own. The video adds proof; the page carries the ask.

awb---key-feature-1-image.alt: Ostler Coaching's sales letter page holds its Enroll for $297 button until 14:20, and last month's count shows 1,840 plays, 612 viewers who reached the offer, and 87 enrollments.

acrm---key-feature-2-image.alt: Tallyhand's trials are grouped by how much of the 90-second demo each person watched, and 131 of last month's 214 trials came from viewers past 60 seconds.

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: Harbor Roofing's table counts plays and quote requests for three customer videos, and the hail damage repair story leads with 58 of 97 requests.

acrm---key-feature-4-image.alt: A personal video page greets Edda Vashti at Maplestone Freight by name, and rep Owen Castillo gets a direct message in Slack when she passes the halfway mark.

alpb---cover-image.alt: A video landing page confirms a free trial after the visitor watched the product demo.
